summary: This bill amends existing law to allow individuals to sue federal officials for constitutional violations of voting rights and election law, similar to how they can currently sue state officials.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends 42 U.S.C. 1983 to allow civil actions against federal officials for constitutional violations of voting rights and election law. Its entire purpose is to expand the ability of citizens to sue over election-related issues, making it highly central to the topic of voting and elections.
